title: Hinomori Shizuku — On A Flashy Stage〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, you need to move faster to keep up with the timing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You're sweating a lot, Minori.
Were you practicing your routine?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, but it's not going very well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's why I'm teaching her.
Alright, Minori, enough talking. Get back to practice!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I used to be really bad at shifting my weight like that too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I was terrible before my debut and destroyed quite a few pairs of dance shoes because of that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had to change practice outfits so many times throughout the day, I ended up with a stack of them... Eventually, I developed my very own routine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, that means I have to practice hard enough to develop two routines!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's that got to do with anything?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come on, stop talking and get back to practice already! Are you really serious about mastering the moves?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I am! Alright, here goes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It took me quite a while before I was finally able to master dance moves like that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I couldn't get it right no matter how hard I practiced, and I was about to give up out of frustration, until...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are you staring at me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Minori.
I really wanted to help you practice, but I have to go to work now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please don't worry about me and enjoy your work, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'll see you both tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Cameraman
rows.Line:
Okay, that's all for the shoot today.
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm glad everything went smoothly...
Thank you, too.

rows.Speaker: Cameraman
rows.Line: All the photos we took today were fantastic. I can't decide which one to use as cover...

rows.Speaker: Cameraman
rows.Line: Hm... I think her face can be seen clearer in the composition of this one here, though.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But they're only talking about my appearance...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I understand that looks are important as an idol, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The idol I really want to be is...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's practicing the same dance moves today too. While I do hope she can become an idol one day...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She'll have to see and go through many things behind the scenes that are quite unsavory, and that may cause her to lose hope...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ah! Hello, Hinomori!
Are you here to watch me today, too?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I was thinking of practicing together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I'm really happy to have you join me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Still, I don't know why but...
When I look at her, I can't help but want to cheer her on.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's practice hard together, Minori.
